title: Best Suitcase Set (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the sources that mentioned them, prioritizing items cited by more than one source. The Samsonite Freeform was highlighted as the best overall by Good Housekeeping, while the American Tourister set was noted as best value.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price caveats are included.
